question: Can the original configured invariant be proved from the bound TLA+ transitions as the participant domain grows or the full graph is infinite?
host: Dedicated Linux AWS c7i.4xlarge, us-east-2, Xeon Platinum 8488C, 16 vCPUs / 8 cores with SMT, 32 GiB. Ubuntu 24.04, OpenJDK 21.0.13.1, CPython 3.12.3, dd 0.6.0 CUDD. Dive/Sail measured using optimized binaries and the local symbolic companion with that Python environment.
method: Unchanged published source and configuration. Use Recomp's upstream --parallel runner (four competing processes). Run each portfolio in a separate disposable systemd unit with 28 GiB and a 610 s watchdog. Read the printed property result and stop remaining children when its driver exits. GNU time maximum RSS is the largest reaped process, not a sum over concurrent JVMs. The systemd memory-peak strings are service-level observations.

The competitor and development worker alternated order over three rounds on the same node. The installed named-property CLI then ran three fresh processes per original and one per grown configuration. Measured installed elapsed time includes process startup, binding, relation construction, closure and induction. Independent session trials use a new candidate directory. No compilation took place during the installed CLI or session measurements.

Extend only Node or RMs with consecutive string identifiers n1..nN or rm1..rmN. The CFG is byte-identical. The lock guard edit adds ~holds_lock[n] to SendLock. The counter-model guard edit adds tmState = "init" to SndPrepare. Fresh edit uses those same revised bytes.

The first development worker computed exact BFS layers before certifying the predicate. Its later sweep/order ablation changes two things jointly: applying actions immediately and ordering finite record messages near their manager. Individual attribution to those two changes was not measured.
commands: cd BENCHMARK_DIR && python3 -u RECOMP_ROOT/recomp-verify.py MODEL.tla MODEL.cfg --parallel
dive check MODEL.tla --config MODEL.cfg --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --property-proof PROPERTY --time-limit 600s
dive check BASE.tla --config BASE.cfg --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --property-proof PROPERTY --recheck EDIT.tla BASE.cfg --recheck BASE.tla BASE.cfg
sail runtime symbolic-check --dive DIVE --session DIR --module MODEL.tla --config MODEL.cfg --type-invariant TypeOK --property-proof PROPERTY --time-limit 120
python3 scripts/symbolic/check_property_proof.py LOCK_DIR/lockserv.tla COUNTER_DIR/TwoPhaseCounter.tla --exporter SYMBOLIC_INPUT --dive DIVE
dive check lockserv.tla --strategy symbolic --type-invariant TypeOK --property-proof Mutex --write-predicate predicate.json; python3 scripts/perf/scale/lockserv_predicate.py CLIENTS predicate.json
dive check MODEL.tla --config MODEL.cfg --store exact --workers 1 --seed 0 --fp 0 --max-states 1000000 --time-limit 120s --max-memory 8g --output json
Run the recorded three-writer released-switch exact search and save its counterexample in dive-trace format. Extend Writers with w4 and preserve MaxWriterRestarts = 1 and the full six-invariant list.
python3 scripts/symbolic/extend_witness.py SlateDBWAL.tla released-switch.cfg four-writers-switch.cfg released-switch.trace --dive DIVE --existing-member w1 --new-member w4 --output four.trace
Repeat with four-writers-fixed.cfg. The independent validator rejects state 14 against Next. The validation and extension times exclude discovery of the base witness.
